description.en: Sidebar Conversation actions for DeepSeek Harness: open the row menu on right-click, rename a Conversation by double-click, copy its session id, and permanently delete it together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起永久删除会话。
